cards.title: Like / want / need
cards.body: Three useful verbs + a thing. Say what you like, what you want, or what you need.
cards.body_cz: Tři užitečná slovesa + věc. Co máš rád, co chceš, co potřebuješ.

table.caption: 3 verbs + noun
rows: you would like to have it

cards.title: he / she + s
cards.body: With he and she, add -s to the verb.
cards.body_cz: U he a she přidej k slovesu -s.

cards.title: want to
cards.body: want to + verb = you wish to do something.
cards.body_cz: want to + sloveso = chtít něco dělat. want to = chtít + infinitiv.
points: to sits between want and the next verb
After to use the base verb: go, work, eat — not goes

cards.title: More examples
cards.body_cz: On / Ona / Oni v CZ, když Match potřebuje jasný pár.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: I / you / we / they → no -s (like, want, need)
he / she / it → with -s (likes, wants, needs)
want to + verb — don't drop to
cards.body_cz: I like (ne likes). She likes (ne like). want to go (ne want go).

cards.title: Gap practice
cards.body: In the gap, fill like / likes / want / wants / need / needs — or to after want.
cards.body_cz: Do mezery dej like / likes / want / wants / need / needs — nebo to po want.
points: Look at the person first: I/you/we/they vs he/she
want to… → gap is often to

cards.title: Remember
points: I / you / we / they → like, want, need (no -s)
want to + verb (I want to go)
Not full grammar theory — just these frames
cards.body_cz: like/want/need + věc. he/she + s. want to + sloveso. On/Ona/Oni pro jasný Match.
